summary: Only prime powers ν = p^e below x₁ contribute; regroup by primes p and identify, in the three cases of χ_K(p), the factor Λ(p^e)(1 − χ_K(p)^e) = log p·(1 − χ_K(p)^e) with 2·log p·((1−χ_K(p))/2)·[e odd or p = d].

steps.claim: Unfold primeSum (the weight λ(ν) = Λ(ν)(1 − χ_K(ν)) for M = 1) as a sum over ν; call the summand G(ν).
steps.lean: simp [primeSum, lambdaClass, Unique.eq_default, ← sum_subtype_eq_sum_filter]; set G := fun _ ↦ _

steps.claim: G(ν) = 0 for ν ≥ ⌈x₁⌉: then y/ν ≤ a/x₁ ≤ w((−ν)σ) (the nominal weight is ≥ a/x₁).
steps.lean: have h0 : ∀ ν ∉ range ⌈D.x₁⌉₊, G ν = 0 := by simp [G]; grw [← (nominalWeight_mem_Icc ..).1]; bound

steps.claim: The sum over ν equals the sum over primes p of the sums over e ≥ 1 of G(p^e) (Λ is supported on prime powers; `tsum_eq_tsum_primes_of_support_subset_prime_powers`); all sums are finite.
The finite ranges match (⌈x₁⌉ ≤ a by size; Λ(0) = 0); compare the terms prime by prime.
steps.lean: grind [(D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound : ⌈D.x₁⌉₊ ≤ D.a), vonMangoldt.map_zero]; congr with ⟨p, hp⟩

steps.claim: Pull log p out of the inner sum and shift the exponent index e ↦ e + 1.
Case p = d: 1 − χ_K(p^e) = 1 and the factor of localAsk is 1/2; case χ_K(p) = 1: both sides vanish; case χ_K(p) = −1: 1 − (−1)^e = 2·[e odd] and the factor is 1. Λ(p^e) = log p.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨rfl, _⟩ | ⟨_, ⟨⟩⟩ := @chiK_cases P.d p ⟨hp⟩ _ <;> simp_all [G, neg_one_pow_eq_ite,
    vonMangoldt_apply_pow, vonMangoldt_apply_prime] <;> grind
